title: tc-integration-settings
description: The settings card of one connected service: a switch, an API key, the site address and a time zone, with a save bar.

count.description: Small number next to the name, e.g. synced orders

meta.description: Line under the name, e.g. when it was connected

values.description: The saved values. Edits collect in the save bar; fields that weren't edited follow new values right away

siteHint.description: Helper text under the address field

timeZones.description: The time zones the picker offers, as labels like "(GMT +01:00) Berlin" – the first is the default

demo.description: Demo mode: keys are made up silently when generateKey is missing
